ItemsOfObject.description: A type in an allOf member says the kind: minItems constrains only arrays, so every object passes.

ItemsOfReference.description: So does the type of an allOf member's $ref target.

ItemsOfOneOf.description: So do the types of all oneOf members together: the kinds of one of them.

ItemsOfAnyOfRefs.description: And of all anyOf members, through $ref too; an array is one of those kinds, so minItems constrains it.

ItemsOfSomeTyped.description: A member without type says nothing, so neither does its group: the keywords say the kind.

ItemsOfEnum.description: const and enum say the kinds of the values they list, as type does: minItems constrains the arrays, and the string passes it.

ItemsOfEnumKinds.description: Values of every kind say theirs: only the empty array fails minItems.

ItemsOfEnumMember.description: So do those of an allOf member.

ItemsOfConstOrArray.description: And of every anyOf member together, const among them.

ItemsOfObjectOrNull.description: So do the kinds of nested members, and the other kinds they name pass dependentRequired.

ClosedTypedMember.description: A typed member that requires a key a closed object forbids keeps its arrays too.

RequiredOrAnyItems.description: anyOf members without type count with the schema's own kinds: objects pass them.

RequiredOrMemberEmpty.description: String keywords in an allOf member count beside the object keywords, as in the schema itself.

IfOfBothKinds.description: An if of both kinds fails for the objects without a, the shorter arrays and the other kinds.

IfShort.description: maxItems in if fails for the longer arrays, which pass without then.

IfAnyLength.description: minItems: 0 in if admits every array.

BranchOfOtherKind.description: A member's then of another kind applies to the values its if admits.

UnknownTypeName.description: A type name JSON Schema does not have admits every value, so every other kind passes dependentRequired.

UnknownTypeMember.description: And passes a member without type.

PrototypeTypeName.description: A name objects inherit is no kind either.

TypedIf.description: A typed if in a member is only a condition: strings fail it and pass.
